semantics.why: Keeps group construction in one place

semantics.how: Creates one unit per group via buildGroupUnit and records each member layer's new parent
semantics.what: Builds complete group units and the layer reparenting map
semantics.why: Gives group shape a single owner before finalizeSnapshot attaches it

semantics.how: Hashes the sorted member ids into a short prefixed id
semantics.what: Derives a group id from its member layer ids
semantics.why: Names are rechosen every run, so ids depend only on membership

semantics.how: Indexes layer units by name, failing on duplicate names, unknown names or a layer claimed twice
semantics.what: Converts group to layer-name mappings into group to layer-id mappings
semantics.why: Collisions or invented names make the grouping untrustworthy, so failures are fatal
